result.summary: Fixed bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash trigger in migration 057 by correcting parameter passing to bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash function. Root cause analysis identified type mismatch (JSONB passed where TEXT expected) and semantic parameter order issues. Fix applied via replace_string_in_file: (1) Swapped actor_id and audit_id to correct positions 2-3, (2) Replaced NEW.payload_full (JSONB) with NEW.trace_id (TEXT) for p_trace_id parameter, (3) Replaced NEW.before_state/NEW.after_state with NULL::JSONB, (4) Replaced NEW.pipeline_run_id with NULL::UUID, (5) Added explicit type casts. Implementation now matches proven working version from migration 051 exactly.
